text:
Maya (CS): Quick sync - AzurLine (regional ISP) requests a transient onboarding change for an upcoming marketing push: new Middle East region routing (me-sd-1), partner CIDR allowlist, SAML SSO enable, and a temporary QPS increase for ~14 days. They also mentioned eventual Private deployment requirements (KMS).

Rashid (AzurLine): Confirming window: 2025-04-10 -> 2025-04-24, business hours 08:00-20:00 GST. Baseline QPS ~200, target burst to 900 for generate routes. Will provide SAML metadata.

Evelyn (NetOps): Please paste CIDRs + expected egress. We can request peering in me-sd-1 but need to reserve PoP; TLS mTLS later?

Rashid (AzurLine): CIDRs: 196.100.8.0/24 and 196.100.9.128/32. Peak egress ~220Mbps. No client certs initially.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Proposed actions: 1) create ephemeral allowlist entries with auto-revoke on 2025-04-25; 2) apply temporary profile "azur-promo-900" scoped to me-sd-1 and tagged routes (/v1/generate); 3) schedule a 30m SAML setup call; 4) start Private deploy discovery ticket for KMS notes.

Liam (AE): Renewal note - customer asked for region residency logs + basic KMS isolation statement. Might influence renewal timeline. I'll draft an attestation to attach to renewal playbook.

Maya (CS): I'll book the SAML call for tomorrow 11:00 GST and prep a short runbook. Rashid - confirm if embeddings also need bump (and any concurrency cap).

Rashid (AzurLine): Only generate endpoints for the promo. Embeddings stay at normal levels.

Evelyn (NetOps): Provision checklist: peering request for me-sd-1; apply allowlist 196.100.8.0/24 and 196.100.9.128/32 (auto-revoke 2025-04-25T00:00:00Z); apply profile azur-promo-900 (08:00-20:00 GST); set alert at 75% of profile; audit logging enabled.

infra-bot: Ticket CS-7882 created. PoP reservation ETA ~20h. Promo profile applied to staging; auto-revoke timer set.

Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll attach the SAML test checklist and include Console steps (ACS URL, SP EntityID, attribute mapping).

Maya (CS): Recap: CS-7882 holds peering, ephemeral allowlist, promo profile, SAML call tomorrow 11:00 GST, renewal attestation owned by Liam. Ping this thread for updates.

Rashid (AzurLine): Thanks team, please ensure allowlist auto-revokes.

Evelyn (NetOps): Noted - audit trail + revoke scheduled. Will post CS-7882 updates here once PoP reserved.

(END)
